articleTitle: Dynamic Modeling and Simulation of Propulsion and Levitation Systems for Hyperloop
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Symposium on Linear Drives for Industry Applications (LDIA)
abstract: Dynamic behavior analysis of propulsion and levitation systems is required to accurately evaluate the performance, energy consumption, and further optimization of the hyperloop high-speed train technology. In this paper, a detailed dynamic model is developed for the hyperloop propulsion and levitation systems. To do this, the finite element model of the levitation is linked to the analytical model of the propulsion system. The dynamic response of the system is evaluated under different wheel retraction and deployment times and for different stator segment lengths.

articleTitle: A Low Current Fluctuation Switching Strategy for Long Primary Linear Motors
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Symposium on Linear Drives for Industry Applications (LDIA)
abstract: Long armature linear motors segmented power supply are often used in acceleration systems such as high-speed maglev transportation. For the stator segments power supply mode in parallel, switching switches is fewer, but the circuit changes during the switching process will cause current fluctuations and long switching process time because the neutral point of the motor is independent for different stator segment connected to the same inverter. A switching strategy that combines segmented neutral connection and current zero-crossing shutdown is proposed to solve this power supply problem. The mathematical model is established and the correctness of the proposed strategy is verified by experiments.

articleTitle: Long Stator Linear Doubly-Fed Motor for High-Speed Maglev Integrated Suspension, Propulsion and Contactless Power Supply
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Symposium on Linear Drives for Industry Applications (LDIA)
abstract: The power rails for onboard power supply are needed for TR high-speed maglev based on liner synchronous motor, which bring up the cost increase and decrease of reliability. Aiming to realize the contactless onboard power supply at low cost, a maglev based on Long Stator Linear Doubly-Fed Motor (LDFM) is proposed in this paper, which can integrate the contactless onboard power supply, suspension and propulsion force generation together. The structure, principle and the decoupled control strategy of the LDFM based maglev is presented. The 2D Finite Element Method (FEM) results verify the effectiveness of the proposed prototype.

articleTitle: Research on Electromagnetic Characteristics of Linear Synchronous Motor for High-Speed Maglev Train Based on Field-Circuit Coupling
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Symposium on Linear Drives for Industry Applications (LDIA)
abstract: As a new type of non-contact transportation mode, high-speed maglev train is mainly used to solve people's demand for fast travel. Linear synchronous motor is the key structure to realize the drive and levitation of maglev train, and its performance determines whether the train can run smoothly and safely. Firstly, the field-circuit coupling model of long stator linear synchronous motor with the maximum operating speed of 600km/h is established based on finite element method, and the electromagnetic characteristic is analyzed. The simulation results of the traction force are compared with the test data of the prototype, which verified the correctness of the calculation model. Secondly, the influence of the relative position of stator and mover and the different operating speed on the traction and levitation characteristics is investigated. Finally, the output parameters of linear motor under inverter fault conditions are calculated, which shows the influence of different types of fault on traction and levitation force.

articleTitle: System-Level Optimization Design of Tubular Permanent-Magnet Linear Synchronous Motor for Electromagnetic Emission
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Symposium on Linear Drives for Industry Applications (LDIA)
abstract: As the core equipment for the electromagnetic emission system, the tubular permanent magnet linear synchronous motor (TPMLSM) is required to be of lighter weight and less power, taking the weight of the pulse power supply system into account. In this paper, a comprehensive optimization design method of TPMLSM is introduced, which is aimed to obtain a system-level optimal solution with strict dimensional and power restrictions. First, the calculation model of TPMLSM performance is established based on magneto-static field (2D-FEM) and response surface methodology (RSM), the precision is validated by transient field (2D-FEM). Then the optimal design procedure of TPMLSM is deduced, revealing clear advantages of the proposed model in design flexibility. Finally, the performances of all designs including both the motor and power system are calculated, listed, and optimized by selecting the optimal power level.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of a Primary Permanent Magnet Transverse Flux Linear Generator for Direct Drive Wave Energy Converters
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Symposium on Linear Drives for Industry Applications (LDIA)
abstract: According to the characteristics of the linear generator for direct drive wave energy converters, a novel primary permanent magnet transverse flux linear generator (TFLG) is studied. The structure has the advantages of simple structure, easy maintenance, and high mechanical strength, which is especially suitable for the harsh marine climate environment. Firstly, the operating principle of the generator is described, and the three-dimensional equivalent model of the generator is established by magnetic circuit method. The mathematical expressions of back electromotive force (EMF) and cogging force are derived. Secondly, the EMF, waveform distortion rate and cogging force are taken as optimization objectives, the key structural parameters of the generator are selected as the influence factors. The local multi-objective optimization of the primary permanent magnet TFLG is carried out by the Taguchi method, and a group of parameters with suitable comprehensive performance are obtained. Finally, the effectiveness of the method is verified by three-dimensional finite element simulation.

articleTitle: A New High Output Frequency Multilevel Inverter Topology of Traction Converter for Superspeed Maglev Train
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Symposium on Linear Drives for Industry Applications (LDIA)
abstract: Superspeed maglev train can achieve a theoretical speed from 1,000 to 4,000 kilometers per hour, which has potential application prospects in transportation, satellite launching and manned space flight in the future. Superspeed maglev train has high acceleration and large back EMF. The running speed of the maglev train is directly proportional to the output frequency of the traction converter. The traction converter is required to output high voltage, large current and high frequency. The control strategy of cascade topology combined with parallel technology can increase the voltage and current of traction converter. Due to the low switching frequency of large-power high-voltage electronic semiconductor devices, the maximum output frequency of the converter is limited. A new high output frequency multilevel inverter topology of traction converter for superspeed maglev train is proposed in this paper. Based on the basic unit of active neutral point clamped H-bridge, the topology has the advantages of frequency-multiplier output, high voltage, large power and balanced loss distribution.

articleTitle: Research on Sensorless Control for Long-stator Linear Synchronous Motors Applied in Maglev Trains under the Influence of Levitation System
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Symposium on Linear Drives for Industry Applications (LDIA)
abstract: For long-stator linear synchronous motors (LSLSM) applied in electromagnetic suspension (EMS) maglev trains, sensorless control schemes are generally considered, especially when the train is running at a high speed. However, as a result of the coupling between the traction control system and the levitation control system on a maglev train, the disturbance occurred in the levitation system will also cause instability of sensorless control applied in the traction system. In this paper, the filtering method is adopted to reduce the disturbances of the levitation system and ensure the stability of the sensorless control scheme in the traction system.

articleTitle: Novel Linear Generator Concepts and Topologies for Wave Energy Conversion Systems: A Review
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Symposium on Linear Drives for Industry Applications (LDIA)
abstract: Ocean Wave energy is a very appealing renewable energy source. This paper reviews various novel linear generator concepts and topologies for wave energy conversion, including novel permanent magnet linear generators, flux modulated linear generators, linear reluctance generators, emerging superconducting linear generators, and doubly fed linear generators.

articleTitle: Adaptive Sliding Mode Observer Based on Phase Locked Loop in Sensorless Control of Permanent Magnet Linear Synchronous Motor
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Symposium on Linear Drives for Industry Applications (LDIA)
abstract: In order to solve the chattering problem and the errors of speed and position is large in the traditional sliding mode control (SMC) for permanent magnet linear synchronous motor (PMLSM), a sensorless control method for adaptive sliding mode observer (SMO) based on phase locked loop (PLL) of PMLSM is proposed. Firstly, an adaptive law of back-electromotive force (back-EMF) is established by using Lyapunov function, and constructed an adaptive SMO. Then, calculate the position and speed by PLL instead of traditional arctangent function, which improved the accuracy of observation. Finally, build the simulation model and the results proved the superiority of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Comparison Between Linear Induction Motor and Linear Primary Permanent Magnet Vernier Motor for Railway Transportation
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Symposium on Linear Drives for Industry Applications (LDIA)
abstract: Linear induction motor has been used in urban railway transportation. However, the thrust and efficiency are relatively low. Recently, linear primary permanent magnet vernier motor is investigated for potential application in railway transportation due to the higher thrust and efficiency, while no comprehensive comparison exists between the linear primary permanent magnet vernier motor and linear induction motor of the same size to prove the feasibility. Therefore, a comparative analysis between the two motors is conducted in this paper. Firstly, a linear induction motor for railway transportation is built. Secondly, a linear primary permanent magnet vernier motor of the same size as the induction motor is designed and optimized. Thirdly, the electromagnetic performance of two motors is compared and analyzed by using finite element method. The results show that the liner primary permanent magnet vernier motor exhibits higher thrust and efficiency. Finally, a small-sized prototype of the linear primary permanent magnet vernier motor is constructed to validate the simulation.

articleTitle: Linear oscillatory electric motor/generators: an overview
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Symposium on Linear Drives for Industry Applications (LDIA)
abstract: Linear oscillatory motion is present in many industrial processes/devices such as: free-piston air compressors, Stirling engines, wave-energy generators, microphones and loudspeakers, ICE valve actuators, etc. Direct drives for such applications based on linear oscillatory 1(3) phase motor/generator (LOM/G) have been developed now for decades to produce higher energy efficiency per given mission profile, with precision power electronics control. Recent progress on LOM/Gs 1(3) phase for constant (resonant) and variable oscillation frequency, with and without PMs, with and without mechanical springs (to boost output and efficiency), including topologies with superhigh thrust density based on magnetic lead screw principle, is discussed in the present overview paper, from competitive topologies and modeling to performance assessment, design, and control, with representative results from the literature.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of a Linear-Rotary Fault-Tolerant Consequent-Pole PM Actuator
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Symposium on Linear Drives for Industry Applications (LDIA)
abstract: Linear-rotary permanent magnet (PM) actuator is a type of multi degree of freedom actuators, which can be widely applied in many fields such as car driving, drilling process. This paper proposes a novel linear-rotary fault-tolerant consequent-pole (CP) PM actuator for an integrated electromagnetic suspension and steering system. The key of the proposed actuator is the special stator and CP rotor. Combined the alternating arrangement structure of armature teeth and fault-tolerant teeth, two sets of orthogonal fractional-slot concentrated-windings embedded in the adjacent slot of armature teeth are employed to achieve linear and rotary motion and their decoupling control, and enhance fault-tolerant capability. By employing CP and flux-modulation structures, not only the airgap flux density can be enhanced along circumferential direction but also higher torque performance with lower PM consumption can be achieved. The relevant electromagnetic performance is predicted by using the finite-element method.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic Analysis of a Springless Linear Oscillatory Machine based on Equivalent Magnetic Circuit
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Symposium on Linear Drives for Industry Applications (LDIA)
abstract: The springless linear oscillatory machine (SLOM) can overcome the defects of large mass, large volume and high cost caused by mechanical springs, making it a prevailing solution for the linear compressor system. In this paper, an electromagnetic analysis of a springless linear oscillatory machine is carried out via established the equivalent magnetic circuit model, which divides the SLOM into a multi-segment structure, and takes the influence of the leakage flux into consideration. Simulation results show that the analytical model can well calculate the electromagnetic characteristics of the motor.

articleTitle: A New Regressive RBF Neural Network Model for Rate-Dependent Hysteresis in Reluctance Actuators
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Symposium on Linear Drives for Industry Applications (LDIA)
abstract: This paper presents a novel hysteresis approximation method for the rate-dependent hysteresis effect in reluctance actuators. The method is described by a regressive radial basis function (RRBF) neural network model, and its parameters are trained by a global optimization algorithm named dynamic opposite learning teaching learning based optimization (DOLTLBO). The regressive structure is adopted for solving the multivalued problem between the input and the output of the hysteresis nonlinearity, and the DOLTLBO algorithm fully exploits the approximation capability of the RRBF model, thus guaranteeing the low complexity of the neural network. Experiments were performed on reluctance actuators, and results show that the new model has high performance in hysteresis approximations for reluctance actuators when compared to previous models such as the RPI Model and the Chua model.

articleTitle: Model Predictive Voltage Control for Linear Induction Machine Without Weighting Factor
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Symposium on Linear Drives for Industry Applications (LDIA)
abstract: The traditional finite-state-model predictive thrust control (FS-MPTC) method for the linear induction machines (LIMs) needs to find proper weighting factor (WF) for adjusting the cost function terms, and the tuning procedures are tedious by enumerating multiple try cases. For solving aforementioned problems, one improved finite-state model predictive voltage control (FS-MPVC) is proposed in this work, which can eliminate the use of the WF from the cost function along with reducing the calculation burden. The reference voltage vector is predicted, based on the concept of deadbeat model predictive control, which can be used to construct a cost function. Through a comprehensive simulation and analysis for a 3-kw linear induction machine (LIM), entire comparisons between both the proposed FS-MPVC and the conventional FS-MPTC have been done. The results show that, the proposed FS-MPVC can successfully attain faster tracing speed, and lower thrust ripple relative to those of the FS-MPTC.

articleTitle: Optimization Design of Moving Magnet Type Permanent Magnet Synchronous Linear Motor based on Long and Short Term Memory Network
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Symposium on Linear Drives for Industry Applications (LDIA)
abstract: In this paper, a new structure of moving magnet type(MMT) permanent magnet synchronous linear motor is proposed. The thrust performance (trust and trust fluctuation) of permanent magnet synchronous linear motor(PMSLM) is improved by changing the structure parameters of the motor. Firstly, the topological structure of the MMT-PMLSM is designed, and the main structural parameters affecting the MMT-PMSLM are analyzed by using semi-analytical network. Then, the long and short term memory network(LSTM) regression modeling method is introduced, and the cuckoo search algorithm is used to adjust the super parameters of the regression modeling. Based on the mapping relationship between motor structure parameters and thrust performance, a regression model is builded. Secondly, The grey wolf optimization algorithm is used to iteratively optimize the regression model, the optimal structural parameters are obtained by taking thrust lifting and reducing thrust fluctuation as the objectives. Finally, the simulation results verify the effectiveness of the motor structure optimization design method to improve the thrust performance.

articleTitle: Quasi-free position control of permanent magnet synchronous linear motor (PMSLM) based on low-resolution Hall sensor
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Symposium on Linear Drives for Industry Applications (LDIA)
abstract: In the AC permanent magnet synchronous linear motor (PMSLM) vector control system, closed-loop feedback is required for the speed and position the mover. The accuracy of the mover's position has a great influence on the closed-loop control performance, so the position identification algorithm which is economical and reliable is needed. Thus, it has become a hot spot in the field of PMLSM and its control. This article studies how to improve the starting performance through a square wave start strategy. This strategy can meet the needs of the mover position estimation through PMSLM field-oriented vector control system in the condition of using discrete low-resolution Hall signal to obtain a continuous high-resolution position.

articleTitle: Design Optimization of Linear Switched Reluctance Motor with Segmental Mover
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Symposium on Linear Drives for Industry Applications (LDIA)
abstract: In this paper, a topology of linear switched reluctance motor with segmental mover (LSRMSM) is investigated and optimized. The novelty of LSRMSM is the segmental mover structure, which makes it suitable for high-thrust linear propulsion. In virtue of the design of experiment (DOE) method and the Kriging (KG) model, the calculation amount of the model is significantly minimized. At the same time, the optimal motor model is obtained through the global search method. The simulation results of finite element analysis (FEA) are delivered to validate the feasibility of the optimization scheme. For exemplification, a prototype is manufactured and implemented to verify the feasibility and effectiveness of the optimization scheme.

articleTitle: Analysis of Permanent Magnet Linear Synchronous Motor made by Oriented Silicon Steel Sheet
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Symposium on Linear Drives for Industry Applications (LDIA)
abstract: This paper presents a novel structure of the permanent magnet linear synchronous motors (PMLSMs). Using oriented silicon steel sheet (OSSS) instead of traditional non-oriented silicon steel sheet (NOSSS) as the mover of the proposed PMLSM. The OSSS possess better magnetic permeability and anti-saturation ability than NOSSS in the rolling direction, so setting the rolling direction is consistent with the magnetic circuit directions of the tooth. By the analysis thrust and saturation effect and employed the finite element software, the results display that the use of OSSS as the mover core material can increase the electromagnetic thrust and overload capacity.

articleTitle: Design and comparison of linear induction motor and superconducting linear synchronous motor for electromagnetic launch
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Symposium on Linear Drives for Industry Applications (LDIA)
abstract: This paper studies on the feasibility of different electromagnetic launch systems for light space vehicles. The design of the linear induction motor and high temperature superconducting linear synchronous motor are proposed based on the launch requirements. This study compares the key performance parameters of the two linear motor topologies. A small prototype was built and static experiments were conducted to verify the rationality of the linear induction motor design. Through theoretical calculation, finite element simulation and experimental verification, this research provides a theoretical basis for the research of linear motors in aerospace electromagnetic launch.

Author Keywords: high temperature superconducting linear synchronous motors

articleTitle: Vector Control Strategy of Permanent Magnet Synchronous Linear Motor Based on Sliding Mode Speed Controller and Model Reference Adaptive
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Symposium on Linear Drives for Industry Applications (LDIA)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of poor stability and low system accuracy in the vector control of permanent magnet synchronous linear motor (PMSLM), a vector control strategy for PMSLM based on model reference adaptive system (MRAS) is proposed. Improve the accuracy of speed and mover position estimation by selecting the appropriate adaptive law, and introduce a sliding mode control (SMC) strategy in the speed loop to optimize the vector control system. The simulation results shows that this method can effectively reduce the overshoot and chattering, and improve the stability of the system.

articleTitle: Nonlinear Equivalent Magnetic Network of a Transverse-Flux Permanent Magnet Linear Motor Based on Combine steel with SMC
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Symposium on Linear Drives for Industry Applications (LDIA)
abstract: In order to overcome the transverse-flux permanent magnet linear motor's (TFPMLM) shortcomings of high leakage flux and high cogging force when the cores are made by silicon steel, a double-sided double-excited TFPMLM has been developed, in which the soft magnetic composite (SMC) material and silicon steel are employed to construct its cores. For the purpose of improving the modeling and calculating efficiency with a high precision, a nonlinear equivalent magnetic network (EMN) model of the TFPMLM is proposed. Moreover, to decrease the computing time much more when solving the magnetic network model, a flexible mesh generation technique is applied. After that, the air-gap flux density distribution, back voltage and force waveforms when at no-load and at load are calculated by the EMN model and 3-D finite-element method, the results from the two methods are compared with each other, respectively. At last, influences of SMC on the cogging force and flux leakage are studied by the EMN model.

articleTitle: Speed Regulation of Linear Induction Motor with Finite State Predictive Thrust Control Based on Sliding Mode Controller
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Symposium on Linear Drives for Industry Applications (LDIA)
abstract: The speed regulation problem of linear induction motor (LIM) is investigated based on sliding mode speed control loop. This sliding mode control (SMC) is designed based on finite state predictive thrust control (FSPTC) to regulate linear speed, primary flux linkage, and electromagnetic thrust. The output of the SMC serves as the reference thrust of the FSPTC. The primary flux linkage and the thrust ripples are reduced based on FSPTC compared to the conventional DTC. Moreover, a comparison between the proposed FSPTC with both SMC and PI control is developed to illustrate the superiority of the SMC in speed regulation where higher tracking accuracy and fast error convergence are achieved. Comprehensive simulation and experimental results are developed based on one 3kW prototype, which fully demonstrate that the enhanced control method can get faster response, lower thrust and primary flux linkage ripples in response to those of conventional methods.

articleTitle: Modelling and Analysis of Two-Phase Winding Segmented Permanent Magnet Linear Synchronous Motor
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Symposium on Linear Drives for Industry Applications (LDIA)
abstract: The winding segmented permanent magnet linear synchronous motor (WS-PMLSM) generally adopts three phase windings and the length of the segment is larger than that of the passive mover. In this work, the stator was divided into module segments whose length was equal to the length of the pole-pairs of the mover, and the winding structure with two-phase perpendicular to each other was proposed for the vector control system without Clark transformation and anti-Clark transformation, the concentric distributed winding was used to realize the sinusoidal magnetomotive force and reduce harmonics, the magnetomotive force function and the specific permeance function were utilized to derive the inductance expression in the whole moving range, the expression was verified by finite element method, the inductance of a prototype was measured and compared with the analytical result. The above results prove the validity of the proposed motor model.

Author Keywords: winding segmented permanent magnet linear synchronous motor (WS-PMLSM)

articleTitle: Design and Optimization of Tubular Linear Vernier Generator for Direct Drive Wave Energy Converter
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Symposium on Linear Drives for Industry Applications (LDIA)
abstract: Tubular linear vernier generator keeps the advantages of high efficiency and low cost of primary permanent magnet linear generator, but it has more flux leakage. First of all, a new type of tubular linear vernier generator is proposed in this paper. The permanent magnet is embedded in the primary teeth by horizontal and vertical magnetization, which effectively solves the problem of more magnetic leakage at the end of the generator and puts forward the concept of modularization, which greatly reduces the cogging force by modularization. Secondly, taking no-load back EMF, waveform distortion rate and cogging force as the optimization objectives, the sensitivity analysis of the optimization variables of the generator is carried out, and the optimization variables with significant sensitivity are selected to build the model based on box Behnken. Thirdly, particle swarm optimization algorithm is used to solve the response surface model and generate a set of Pareto solutions, so as to obtain the optimal structural parameters of the generator. Finally, the cogging force, output voltage quality and other performance of the optimized generator are calculated and analyzed based on the two-dimensional finite element method, and the multi-objective optimization based on the response surface model and particle swarm optimization algorithm is verified the effectiveness of the design method based on modularization.

Author Keywords: cylindrical linear vernier permanent magnet generator

articleTitle: Multiple-phase Excitation Control of Linear Switched Reluctance Motor with Segmented Secondary Driving System
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Symposium on Linear Drives for Industry Applications (LDIA)
abstract: This paper aims to present the control strategy for a new class linear switched reluctance motor with segmented secondary (LSRMSS). The prominent advantages of the presented LSRM is that the machine features segmental secondary which consists of mechanical isolated magnetic core. Compared to conventional LSRM, the presented machine has higher thrust density and efficiency. The control strategy for this new class linear switched reluctance motor by employing multiple-phase excitation mode is investigated. The presented strategy is to use a force control distribution function to calculate the required force shared by each excited phase. A comprehensive model combined with FEA is established to validate the feasibility of the presented strategy. The results indicate that it can significantly reduce force fluctuations in commutations area and significantly increase the stability of the motor operation. Finally, the prototype is fabricated and experiments are done.

articleTitle: Force Ripple Suppression of Permanent Magnet Linear Synchronous Motor Based on Fuzzy Adaptive Kalman Filter
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Symposium on Linear Drives for Industry Applications (LDIA)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the noise covariance matrix is difficult to get when using the Kalman filter to observe the force, a force ripple suppression strategy of permanent magnet linear synchronous motor based on fuzzy adaptive Kalman filter is proposed. According to the fuzzy control theory, this method takes the error of the q-axis current and rate of the error as fuzzy controller inputs, and takes the parameter in the covariance matrix of the measurement noise as fuzzy controller output, which reduces the burden of parameter tuning and improve disturbance rejection performance. The experimental results show that compared with the Kalman filter with fixed parameters, the method proposed in this paper has better dynamic performance.

articleTitle: Parameter Identification of Permanent Magnet Synchronous Linear Motors Using Multi-Innovation Least Squares Method
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Symposium on Linear Drives for Industry Applications (LDIA)
abstract: The identification of dynamic model parameters of the permanent magnet synchronous linear motors (PMSLMs) is the foundation of high-performance motor control. To address the low accuracy of modelling of PMSLMs, a parameter identification method of the PMSLM is proposed by using multi-innovation least squares (MILS) approach in this paper. The linear transfer function of the PMSLM is first built. Then the MILS approach based on the recursive least squares (RLS) algorithm is developed to identify the parameters of the built model. Finally, the simulation results of MILS and RLS algorithms are shown, and the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified.

articleTitle: Development of Thermal Network for a High Power Linear Ultrasonic Motor with V-Shape Stator
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Symposium on Linear Drives for Industry Applications (LDIA)
abstract: This work addressed rapid prediction of the temperature rise for high power linear ultrasonic motor by developing a 2D thermal network model. Firstly, a six terminal equivalent circuit for Langevin transducer considering the piezoelectrics with three losses was proposed to calculate the stator loss. Then the calculated losses are used as inputs to the nodal thermal network model that introduces a thermal circuit for the clamping part and computes the temperature rise for different parts of the motor. Finally, the temperature rise experiment for a high power linear ultrasonic motor with V-shape stator was conducted to validate the presented model.

articleTitle: Diagnosis of Current Sensor Faults in Open Winding Permanent-Magnet Linear Motor Drive Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Symposium on Linear Drives for Industry Applications (LDIA)
abstract: In this article, a fault diagnosis method of current sensors for open winding permanent-magnet linear motor (OWPMLM) drive systems was proposed. For the gain fault and zero-offset fault, the signal fault characteristics is different from that of traditional machine with Y-connected winding. This means that existing methods cannot be directly to diagnosis these faults in OWPLM drive systems. In the proposed method, <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">${d-}$</tex> and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$q$</tex>-axis currents are estimated by a current observer. The residual errors are calculated by estimated and measured currents. The fluctuation amplitude of current error is used to judge the fault. The fluctuation period of current error is used to distinguish the fault type, and the fault diagnosis index is used to locate the fault phase. This proposed method can detect fault, distinguish fault type and locate fault phase effectively. Finally, simulations verify the effectiveness of the proposed fault diagnosis method.

articleTitle: Thermal Modeling of Tubular Permanent Magnet Linear Synchronous Motor Based on Random Forest
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Symposium on Linear Drives for Industry Applications (LDIA)
abstract: This paper proposed a novel thermal modeling analysis method of tubular permanent magnet linear synchronous motor(PMLSM) based on machine-leaning method. Firstly, the structure and main parameters and the finite element (FE) thermal modeling of motor are introduced. A small sample about the average temperature rise of permanent magnet, overall average temperature rise of PMLSM and coil temperature rise are obtained by FE method, corresponding to different heat source inputs. Based on the sample dataset, a powerful machine learning algorithm called Random Forest(RF) is employed to fit the function relationship between output design objectives and input sources parameters. The accuracy of thermal prediction model is verified by the remaining group of sample data. Comprehensive performance comparison shows that the motor thermal prediction model was established by RF is better than other methods such as KNN and SVM.

articleTitle: Starting strategy and self-tuning technology of permanent magnet linear synchronous motor (PMLSM) based on Hall sensor
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Symposium on Linear Drives for Industry Applications (LDIA)
abstract: In order to improve the velocity regulation performance of permanent magnet linear synchronous motor (PMLSM), switched Hall sensors are used to estimate the velocity and electric angle of the mover, and the vector closed-loop control is carried out. The current closed-loop starting strategy based on current frequency control is adopted to improve the starting performance of the motor. Combined with the characteristic of “thrust power angle self-balance”, this paper puts forward a kind of technology to determine the actual installation distance of Hall sensor by Hall signal jump time after the motor velocity is stable, so as to improve the estimation accuracy of motor velocity and electric angle, and improve the closed-loop control performance. Simulation and experiment verify the effectiveness of the start-up strategy and self-tuning technology.

articleTitle: A Swing Start-up Strategy of Modular Free Piston Linear Generator Based on State Identification
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Symposium on Linear Drives for Industry Applications (LDIA)
abstract: This paper proposes a modular free-piston linear generator(M-FPLG) which consists of a combustion chamber, air spring, and linear motor. In the start-up stage, the motor needs to generate a lot of electromagnetic force to push the piston to the designated position, while the motor thrust of the M-FPLG is insufficient for the purpose of lightweight design, so it is difficult for the traditional position control strategy to achieve the high compression ratio required during the start. This paper presents a swing startup strategy for M-FPLG based on state identification. By using the principle of swing, the electromagnetic force is adjusted according to the state, so that the energy of the system increases continuously in the process of reciprocating motion until reaching the starting requirements. Simulation analysis and experimental verification are carried out for the proposed control strategy, whose results prove the effectiveness of the control strategy.

articleTitle: Research on the Position-Speed Measuring System for High-Speed Long Primary Linear Induction Motor
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Symposium on Linear Drives for Industry Applications (LDIA)
abstract: Position or speed signals are the key control parameters in long primary linear induction motor (LPLIM) drives. This paper quantitatively analyses the relationship between the speed measuring error and the motor thrust. The system allowable measurement error with the premise satisfying certain thrust fluctuation range under high speed is deduced in this paper. Based on the above results, the design of the grating strips is optimized. Even if the mover is crossing the rail gap, the error of the speed measurement system can still be kept within the range of thrust fluctuations, and specially, the accuracy requirements for track installation are reduced. Finally, the simulation and experiments verification are completed.

articleTitle: Power Supply Method and Inductance Measurement Research on Linear Induction Motor
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Symposium on Linear Drives for Industry Applications (LDIA)
abstract: End effect of linear induction motor (LIM) brings asymmetry to the inductance matrix, leading to the imbalance of current and thrust ripples. In order to eliminate the current imbalance, inductance measurements and calculations are analyzed in this paper. The voltage strategy is designed through calculations of parameters of three-phase equivalent circuit and current results. The calculated results are validated by the experiments on a prototype of LIM.

articleTitle: Research on Thrust Ripple of Aperiodic Transient Linear Induction Motors
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Symposium on Linear Drives for Industry Applications (LDIA)
abstract: Because of its simple structure, linear induction motor(LIM) is widely used in rail transit, precise positioning, and electromagnetic emission. Due to the dynamic longitudinal end effect, the distribution of the magnetic field is distorted. As a result, the axial thrust of the motor fluctuates twice the power supply frequency. In this paper, taking pulse-driven high-speed linear induction motor as an example, the thrust performance under the influence of end effect is analyzed, whether under the excitation of a voltage source or current source. Combined with the characteristics of motor aperiodic transient motion, the influence of variable parameters on thrust ripple coefficient is analyzed. It is revealed that the thrust ripple of aperiodic transient LIM presents unsteady characteristics, which is different from that of traditional LIM.

articleTitle: Performance Comparison and Optimization of Permanent Magnet Flux Switching Linear Motor for Ropless Elevator System
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Symposium on Linear Drives for Industry Applications (LDIA)
abstract: Due to the continuous rise of buildings, ropless elevator systems have gradually attracted widespread attention. Permanent magnet flux switching linear motor (PMFSLM), which the advantages of high thrust density, high power density, high power factor and high reliability is suitable for ropeless elevator systems. In this paper, the conventional permanent magnet flux switching linear motor(PMFSLM) for ropless elevator system are analyzed and a novel U-type permanent magnet flux-switching linear motor (UPM-FSLM) is proposed. Through changing the positional arrangement of the permanent magnets, which reduced magnetic leakage and improved the thrust density and power factor of UPM-FSLM. By finite element analysis (FEA), compared the electromagnetic performance of two motors, including magnetic field, back electromagnetic force (back-EMF), thrust force, and thrust force ripple are simulated. The comparison results verified that UPM-FSLM with higher thrust density, lower thrust ripples and higher structural strength. In order to verify the feasibility of applying PMFSLM to the ropeless elevator system. The test results show that PMFSLM is suitable for the ropless elevator system.

articleTitle: Improved Sliding Mode Control of Permanent Magnet Linear Synchronous Motor Speed based on Variable Exponential Reaching Law
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Symposium on Linear Drives for Industry Applications (LDIA)
abstract: A variable exponential approaching law is designed, which shortens the approaching time of the traditional approaching law sliding surface and improves the speed of the system. On the basis of variable exponential approaching law, aiming at the shortcomings of traditional PID control, a sliding mode switching function with a given speed as a variable is proposed. A simulation model of a permanent magnet synchronous linear motor was built through theoretical analysis, and the model was verified. Through verification, an improved sliding mode switching function is obtained, whether there is overshoot when following given speeds, and the rapidity is good. When following a dynamic given speed, the following rapidity is good and the error is small. When there is system disturbance and load disturbance, the system has better robustness.

articleTitle: Magnetic Field Calculation of the Eccentric Surface-mounted Permanent Magnet Machine
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Symposium on Linear Drives for Industry Applications (LDIA)
abstract: This paper presents an analytical method for predicting magnetic field of surface-mounted permanent magnet synchronous machine (SPMSM) with rotor eccentricity. The surface current is added to stator so as to compensate the MMF drop across stator teeth. An equivalent transformation method is proposed to solve the analytical calculation problem resulted from rotor eccentricity. Then the subdomain method is adopted to calculate magnetic field of the eccentric machine. The proposed method is evaluated on the 6p/36s and 8p/12s SPMSM, and exhibits good agreement with the FEM results.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of a Novel Double Sided Flux Adjustable Linear Permanent Magnet Eddy Current Brake
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Symposium on Linear Drives for Industry Applications (LDIA)
abstract: To overcome the difficult control problem of the braking force in the linear permanent magnet brakes, a novel double sided flux adjustable linear permanent magnet eddy current brake is presented. The structure and operation principle are addressed. To avoid the excessive computation time and cost of adopting the numerical method, a practical analytical model based on the magnetic equivalent circuit method is established, and verified using 3D finite element analysis. Finally, further analysis employing the developed analytical model is carried out to explore the influence of key parameters on the braking force characteristic.

articleTitle: Online Magnetizing Inductance Identification Strategy of Linear Induction Motor Based on Second-Order Sliding-Mode Observer and MRAS
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Symposium on Linear Drives for Industry Applications (LDIA)
abstract: The magnetizing inductance in linear induction motor (LIM) is heavily influenced by the dynamic end effect. Considering that the accuracy of magnetizing inductance usually plays an important role in control system, an online magnetizing inductance estimation strategy for LIM is proposed in this paper. It is based on the back electromotive force (EMF) model reference adaptive system (MRAS) and second-order sliding-mode supertwisting algorithm (STA). Compared to the conventional flux based MRAS identification strategy, there is no pure integration and differential operation in both reference and adaptive models for the proposed method so that integral initial values, DC bias and high-frequency-noise amplification problems can be solved. Stability analysis is given by using the Popov's criterion for hyperstability. Comprehensive simulation and experimental results are given to verify the effectiveness.

articleTitle: Linear Hall Position Calculation Method of PMLSM Based on Type-III PLL
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Symposium on Linear Drives for Industry Applications (LDIA)
abstract: In this paper, a linear Hall position calculation method of PMLSM based on type-III phase-locked loop (PLL) is proposed. In addition, the linear Hall sensor is used to detect the position, and the PLL is used to calculate the position, thus realizing the error-free tracking of the solved position of PMLSM in acceleration and deceleration stages. In order to solve the problem that the traditional PLL can't track the acceleration signal without error, type-III PLL is studied. By designing parameters such as shear frequency and low order harmonic attenuation coefficient, the dynamic and static ability of position calculation is improved. Finally, through the simulation analysis of the whole position detection system, the effectiveness of this method is verified.

articleTitle: Analysis and optimization of An Ironless Linear Synchronous Motor with Cooling System
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Symposium on Linear Drives for Industry Applications (LDIA)
abstract: This paper investigating an ironless linear synchronous motor with cooling system. Firstly, topology of this ironless linear synchronous motor with cooling system is introduced. Flux density in the cooling system is obtained analytically by the separation of variables method according to the boundary conditions. The eddy current braking force introduced by the cooling system is calculated and validated by finite element method. The motor parameters are optimized to improving the eddy current braking force. At last, a prototype motor is designed and established to validating the analysis and optimization results.

articleTitle: Temperature Field Analysis of Primary Permanent Magnet Linear Motor with Magnetic Barrier Coupling
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Symposium on Linear Drives for Industry Applications (LDIA)
abstract: Magnetic barrier coupled primary permanent magnet linear motor (MBCPPMLM) has broad application potential in rail transit drive system. In order to improve the operation reliability, this paper studies the temperature field of MBCPPMLM. Based on the analysis and elaboration of the heating mechanism of the motor, with the help of the finite element analysis software, the three-dimensional simulation model of the motor is built, the temperature field is simulated and analyzed, and the temperature field distribution law of the motor under the condition of natural convection is obtained. The fan cooling system is used to suppress the temperature rise of the motor. Through the finite element analysis software, the highest temperature of this kind of motor is armature winding. Under the natural convection condition, the highest temperature can reach 111.79 °C. After using the fan cooling system, the highest temperature of armature winding drops to 65.86 °C, decreasing by 45.93 °C. It has a significant effect on the temperature rise control of the motor. It provides a reference value for the research of temperature rise and cooling system of this kind of motor.

articleTitle: Research on Parameters Identification Strategy of High-Speed Maglev Train in Double-end Power Supply Mode
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Symposium on Linear Drives for Industry Applications (LDIA)
abstract: The electromagnetic suspension (EMS) maglev train is driven by a linear synchronous motor (LSM) with a long primary and a short secondary. The stator sections adopt a segmented power supply method. During the operation of the train, the feeder cable parameters change with the length of the feeder cable. To improve the traction control performance of the linear motor, the parameters of the feeder cable need to be identified online. In this paper, the mathematical model of the long-stator linear synchronous motor in the double feeding power supply mode is first established. Then, based on the mathematical model of the power supply system, an adaptive observer is constructed, and the adaptive law for estimating the resistance of the feeder cable is derived. A simulation model is built in Simulink, and the simulation results show that the algorithm proposed in this paper is correct and effective.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic aspects of the structural integration of linear synchronous machines for a hyperloop technology
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Symposium on Linear Drives for Industry Applications (LDIA)
abstract: The use of linear synchronous machines (LSM) with long stators is an attractive technology for high-speed transportation. The design optimization of such a machine in terms of force requirements and power density for a hyperloop technology, was reported previously. Due to the high magnetic loading, stator fluxes are at risk of redistributing in the assembly structure, creating losses and drag forces. A configuration is proposed, that assures structural integrity for loads in hyperloop technologies, whilst assuring high efficiency. A comparison of two suitable electromagnetic steels is made using transient loss calculations.

articleTitle: Calculation and analysis of electromagnetic vibration of transverse flux linear oscillation motor with moving stator
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Symposium on Linear Drives for Industry Applications (LDIA)
abstract: The transverse flux linear oscillation motor with moving stator is taken as the research object, and the vibration characteristics of the motor are analyzed and calculated. Firstly, the influence of rotor eccentricity on the magnetic field distribution in the air gap is analyzed and calculated. Moreover, by establishing the equivalent vibration model of the motor stator, the modal shapes of the motor stator and the mover are calculated respectively. In addition, the response spectrum of the eccentric mover is analyzed through the coupling calculation of electromagnetic field and mechanical field. Finally, the modal combination principle is used to calculate the resonant frequency range when the rotor axis deviates from the stator axis. This study laid a foundation for the subsequent optimization design.

articleTitle: Research on Braking Characteristics of Rail Eddy Current Brake with AC Excitation
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Symposium on Linear Drives for Industry Applications (LDIA)
abstract: This paper describes an eddy current brake (ECB) device consisting of AC excitation and ferromagnetic railway. The braking force can be generated with non-contact and low noise caused by the reaction between the eddy current and excitation current. In this paper, the structure of the brake is introduced detailedly. In addition, the three-dimensional finite element analysis (FEA) model of ECB is established. Meanwhile, the experiment system of the rail ECB is built to study the braking characteristics. The validity of FEA simulation is verified by experimental results. It is found that with the increase of speed, the braking force increases linearly to a maximum value first, then slowly decreases, while the normal attractive force decreases continuously. The braking characteristic matches the requirements for the high-speed running trains which need large braking force and low normal force in the deceleration process, so it can be used as an auxiliary braking method in the high-speed railway.

articleTitle: Load Disturbance Suppression of Permanent Magnet Synchronous Linear Motor Based on a Discrete-Time Extended Sliding Mode Observer
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Symposium on Linear Drives for Industry Applications (LDIA)
abstract: This paper proposed a discrete-time extended sliding mode observer (ESMO) to reduce the influence of load thrust mutation on the linear motor and improve the anti-interference ability of the system. First, the electrical model and dynamic model of linear motor are established. Second, the extended state equation of velocity and load thrust is given, and the error between the actual velocity and the observed velocity is selected as the sliding mode surface. Then, an adaptive discrete-time piecewise reaching law is designed to establish the extended sliding mode observer. The observed load thrust is compensated to the controller in the form of feedforward. Finally, a series of comparative experiments were carried out to verify the effectiveness and correctness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Optimization Design of PMSLM Based on Lasso Regression with Embedded Analytical Model
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Symposium on Linear Drives for Industry Applications (LDIA)
abstract: A lasso regression with embedded analytical model (EAM), called EAM-LR, is proposed to quickly and accurately calculate the thrust performance of the permanent magnet synchronous linear motor (PMSLM) in this paper, and combined with the EAM-LR, the chaotic golden section search algorithm (CGA) was introduced to optimize the PMSLM structure to achieve high thrust density and low thrust ripple. First, the PMSLM thrust performance was analyzed by analytical model (AM) to determine the variation range of structural design parameters. Based on the variation range, a finite-element sample database was established. Then, combined with the finite-element sample database, the analytical mapping functions derived from AM, were integrated into Lasso regression to establish EAM-LR. Finally, CGA was introduced to optimize the performance of PMSLM, and simulation experiment comparison proves the effectiveness of the proposed method.

Index Terms: Least Absolute Shrinkage And Selection Operator

articleTitle: A Novel Force Ripple Reduction Method of Tubular Linear Switched Reluctance Actuators based on Multi-stages Translator Poles
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Symposium on Linear Drives for Industry Applications (LDIA)
abstract: Tubular linear switched reluctance actuator (TLSRA) with transverse flux has several advantages of simple structure, low cost and high force density, but it still suffers from relatively high force ripple that prevent it from many applications. In this paper, a novel multi-stages configuration of translator poles is proposed to reduce the force ripple of TLSRA. Based on the transversal flux distribution from finite element analysis (FEA), the original ring-shape translator pole is divided into two or three groups by considering the symmetry of radial force, and each group is shifted with certain displacement in the longitudinal direction. The thrust force distribution of TLSRA is then investigated after the force characteristic by a phase is obtained by three-dimensional FEA. Finally, the sensitivity analysis of displacement between adjacent stages on force ripple is carried out, and the reduction in force ripple factors at different displacement are presented for design optimization. Furthermore, the proposed method has no change in electromagnetic design process, and there is no additional coils or permanent magnets, which makes the method more cost effective.

articleTitle: A New Four-Phase Current Distribution Strategy for the Novel 6-DOF Maglev Motor
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Symposium on Linear Drives for Industry Applications (LDIA)
abstract: In order to decouple the electromagnetic thrust and levitation force of the 6 degree-of-freedom (DOF) maglev motor developed in the laboratory, a new four-phase current distribution strategy of the 6-DOF maglev is proposed in this paper. First, the motor structure is given, in which the mover is composed of four Halbach permanent magnet arrays, and the stator coils consist of a printed circuit board (PCB). Then, the mathematical models of electromagnetic thrust and levitation force of the motor are established based on the Lorentz force law. Moreover, the four-phase current of the stator coils is deduced by coordinate transformation and minimum norm constraint, and the relationship among the electromagnetic thrust force, levitation force, ac axis current, and dc axis current are formulated. The decoupling model of electromagnetic thrust and levitation force of the motor is built. Finally, the simulation results show the effectiveness of the proposed strategy.

articleTitle: Three Dimensional Magnetic Equivalent Circuit Analysis of the Modified Homopolar Linear Synchronous Machine
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Symposium on Linear Drives for Industry Applications (LDIA)
abstract: In this paper, a three dimensional magnetic equivalent circuit (3D-MEC) model is proposed for the modified homopolar linear synchronous machine (H-LSM), which analyzes the air gap flux density, flux linkage, back EMF and electromagnetic forces. By adopting the 3D-MEC method, the computing time for H-LSM is largely reduced with considerable computation accuracy at the same time, which is verified by the three dimensional finite element model (3D-FEM). Therefore, the preliminary design progress can be speeded up via the 3D-MEC model.

Author Keywords: three dimensional magnetic equivalent circuit method (3D-EMC)

articleTitle: Performance comparison of three types of PWM techniques for a Five-phase PMSM with a single-phase open circuited
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Symposium on Linear Drives for Industry Applications (LDIA)
abstract: The work looks at the feasible PWM techniques for a five-phase Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor (5Φ-PMSM) with a single-phase open-circuited. The 5Φ-PMSM particularly suits the long travel segment-powered linear motor application largely thanks to its high thrust and good fault-tolerant capacity. Before enabling these advantages in the context of the linear movement, one fundamental issue regarding the fault-tolerant PWM technique is worth an in-depth discussion. In light of this, this paper develops three types of PWM techniques, i.e., sinusoidal PWM (SPWM), space vector PWM (SVPWM), and min-max carrier-based PWM (min-max CBPWM), such that the faulty motor drive can well accommodate the state-of-the-art fault-tolerant field-oriented control (FOC) philosophy. Merits and demerits in terms of DC voltage utilization, harmonic current content, and complexity are comparatively studied via simulation.

articleTitle: Investigation on the 36MVA PP-IGBT-Based Power Converter for High-Speed Maglev Applications
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Symposium on Linear Drives for Industry Applications (LDIA)
abstract: Press-pack insulated gate bipolar transistors (PP-IGBTs) are a more attractive choice for high-power converters, due to increased current ratings, and an inherent short-circuit failure mode. This paper shows how a power electronics building block (PEBB) based on PP-IGBTs has been carefully designed and assembled to build a 36MVA power converter for high-speed maglev applications. The minimization of the stay inductance, the equalization of power loss and snubberless operation are within the main technical design requisites. Simulation and experiment results show that the developed PEBB based on PP-IGBTs is proved to be suitable for the 36MVA power converter.

articleTitle: High Precision Control of Flux Switching Linear Rotary Machine for Reelwinder
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Symposium on Linear Drives for Industry Applications (LDIA)
abstract: Since there is still large amplitude of the detent force of a flux switching linear rotary machine, the response time is long using space vector pulse width modulation control method when it works in linear motion at low speed. In order to reduce the disturbances, the sliding mode control method is adopted both in linear and rotary motions direction. An improved two degree of freedom permanent magnet flux linkage sliding mode observer is designed, which can suppress the torque and thrust pulsation of the motor and retain the torque and thrust output capacity. The stability and accuracy of the system have been greatly improved, which are verified by the experiment test.

articleTitle: Thrust Control of Long Primary Double-sided Linear Induction Motor Segmented in Parallel Fed by a Single Inverter
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Symposium on Linear Drives for Industry Applications (LDIA)
abstract: To reduce the thrust fluctuation of long primary double-sided linear induction motor (LP-DSLIM) segmented in parallel fed by a single inverter, a secondary field-oriented control strategy is proposed. First, the voltage and flux equations of a DSLIM module are presented. Then, the LP-DSLIM system segmented in parallel is analyzed, and the secondary flux linkage and thrust state equations of the system are developed. The control expressions of secondary flux linkage and thrust in the total secondary flux reference frame are derived. A total secondary field-oriented control strategy is proposed. Finally, the simulation results show that the proposed control strategy reduces the thrust fluctuation effectively.

Author Keywords: long primary double-sided linear induction motor

articleTitle: Model Predictive Control with Common-Mode Voltage Minimization for a Three-level NPC Inverter PMLSM Drive System
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Symposium on Linear Drives for Industry Applications (LDIA)
abstract: This paper proposes a model predictive control (MPC) strategy for a three-level neutral point clamped (NPC) inverter permanent magnet synchronous linear motor (PMLSM) drive system considering Common-Mode Voltage (CMV) suppression. The traditional finite set model predictive control (FS-MPC) has the problems of large calculation amount and large current ripple. The method proposed in this paper is also based on FS-MPC. The difference is that the number of switch combinations corresponding to the space voltage vector is reduced to suppress CMV, and the switch combination traversed at the current moment is adjacent to the optimal switch combination at the previous moment. The simulation results show that the control method has good performance in both steady state and dynamic performance, which verifies the effectiveness of this method.

articleTitle: Modeling and Analysis of a Flux-Switching Transverse-Flux Permanent Magnet Tube Linear Motor
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Symposium on Linear Drives for Industry Applications (LDIA)
abstract: A Novel flux-switching transverse-flux permanent magnet tube linear motor is investigated in this paper, both permanent magnet and armature winding of the motor are fixed on the one side, the other side merely contains core. The motor is convenient for manufacturing and suitable for low-speed large torque direct-drive applications. Firstly, the basic structure and working principle of the motor are introduced in detail. Secondly, the expression of electromagnetic force is deduced by a basic magnetic circuit model. Then, the basic characteristic of the novel motor is analyzed by finite element method (FEM), such as back electromagnetic force (back EMF) and cogging torque. At last, the influence of structure parameters on the magnetic field distribution and cogging force is investigated, which provides a useful foundation for optimum design of the novel transverse flux motor.

Author Keywords: permanent magnet tube linear motor component

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis of GIS Disconnector Based on BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Symposium on Linear Drives for Industry Applications (LDIA)
abstract: When a fault occurs, the current of the GIS isolating switch will change greatly compared with the normal operating state of the angle of rotation. The fault diagnosis method based on BP neural network is adopted. First, collect the current and rotation angle signals. Then extract relevant features for network training. Finally, the diagnosis model is used to diagnose the fault of the GIS isolating switch. Simulation and experiment show that this method can effectively improve the fault recognition rate.

articleTitle: Study of Eccentricity in a Tubular Linear Flux Switching Machine Using 3D Finite Element Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Symposium on Linear Drives for Industry Applications (LDIA)
abstract: This contribution presents the study of eccentricity in a tubular linear (TL) flux switching (FS) permanent magnet (PM) (TLFSPM) machine using 3D finite element analysis. Regarding the 3D nature of magnetic flux under eccentricity fault, 3D finite element (FE) method is used for that purpose. The developed 3D FE models construction and exploitation are presented in details. The effect of eccentricity is studied under open-circuit and load conditions.

articleTitle: Development of the Method of Suppressing Thrust Fluctuation in Permanent Magnet Linear Synchronous Motor
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Symposium on Linear Drives for Industry Applications (LDIA)
abstract: Permanent Magnet Linear Synchronous Motor (PMLSM) is widely used in lithography, electromagnetic ejection, cordless elevator, rail transit and other fields because of the advantages of its high thrust density, high accuracy, high acceleration, low noise, etc. However, PMLSM has large thrust fluctuation which affects its operation efficiency. At present, the study of suppressing thrust fluctuation mainly includes two aspects: optimization design of motor structure and control strategy. In this paper, the method of suppressing thrust fluctuation is summarized from the optimization design of motor structure. The paper mainly summarizes the optimization of primary structure and secondary structure.

articleTitle: Thrust characteristic improvement of permanent magnet linear synchronous motor based on multiobjective optimization
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Symposium on Linear Drives for Industry Applications (LDIA)
abstract: In order to improve the thrust characteristic of permanent magnet linear synchronous motor (PMLSM), the finite element method is used to analyze the influence of twelve parameters on thrust characteristics. Six of them are selected as the optimization variables based on Taguchi method. Using the multi-objective optimization assisted with the kriging model, the results show that the optimized PMLSM has a 64% reduction in thrust ripple and a 6.6% increase in average thrust compared with the original PMLSM.

articleTitle: A Linear Eddy Current Speed Sensor for Speed Measurement of Magnetic and Nonmagnetic Conductive Objects
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Symposium on Linear Drives for Industry Applications (LDIA)
abstract: This paper presents a novel structure of contactless eddy current speed sensor for linear speed measurements of flat shape type conductive objects. The sensor consists of one excitation coil and two different antiserially connected pick up coils. The sensor is designed and analyzed with an air core and a magnetic yoke (core) to compare their drawbacks and merits at different excitation frequencies and low and high speeds. 2D and 3D finite element method and developed analytical methods are utilized for parametric analysis and design of linear eddy current speed sensor. The simulation results are compared with the measurements up to 15.5 m/s.

articleTitle: Calculation of Stator Natural Frequencies of Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motors Considering Complex Boundary Conditions
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Symposium on Linear Drives for Industry Applications (LDIA)
abstract: The accurate calculation and reasonable adjustment of the natural frequencies of the stator are crucial to improve electromagnetic vibration and noise in the electrical machines. The existing calculation methods for the natural frequencies of the stator have a lot of simplifications, which results in low accuracy. In this paper, the stator core is regarded as a ribbed cylindrical shell, the displacement functions of the mid-surface in the cylindrical shell are dispersed as a superposition of orthogonal functions by Gram-Schmidt orthogonalization method, the characteristic equations of natural frequencies of the stator under different boundary conditions are derived based on the energy method, and the natural frequencies including axial and circumferential modal shapes are obtained.

articleTitle: Detent Force and Thrust Ripple Reduction of Dual-Side Toroidal-Winding Linear Permanent Magnet Vernier Machine by Unequal End-Teeth Width
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Symposium on Linear Drives for Industry Applications (LDIA)
abstract: Linear permanent magnet vernier machines (LPMVMs) have attracted more and more attention last several years due to its high thrust density at low speed, which is very suitable for the direct-drive applications. In this paper, the dual-side toroidal-winding LPMVM with unequal end-teeth width is proposed for the reduction of the detent force and thrust ripple. The detent force reduction in the proposed LPMVM is achieved by optimizing unequal end-teeth width for obtaining the two single-side detent forces with the opposite phase angle. The low thrust ripple can be obtained by selecting the lower detent force under the symmetry three-phase flux linkage condition. The unbalanced magnetic pull in the proposed LPMVM is also discussed in this paper by the finite element analysis (FEA). Compared with the conventional dual-side toroidal-winding LPMVM with the equal end-teeth width, the FEA results shows the detent force is reduced from 63.4 N to 6.3 N and the thrust ripple is reduced from 6.4% to 2% in the proposed LPMVM.

articleTitle: Joint Kalman Observer for Mechanical Multi-Parameter Decoupling Estimation of Permanent Magnet Synchronous Linear Motor
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Symposium on Linear Drives for Industry Applications (LDIA)
abstract: A novel decoupling parameter estimation strategy based on Joint Kalman Observer (JKO) is proposed in this paper to estimate whole mechanical multi-parameter of Permanent Magnet Synchronous Linear Motor (PMSLM). First, a mechanical motion model of PMSLM with multiple mechanical parameter disturbances is established. Secondly, In order to eliminate the influence of noise on parameter identification, a JKO is designed, which can quickly observe the system state and disturbance. In addition, Aiming at the characteristics of the limited travel of PMSLM, a simple decoupling identification strategy of multiple mechanical parameters of PMSLM is proposed. Finally, simulation results show the validity of the proposed parameter estimation approach.

articleTitle: Detent Force Reduction Design for the C-Core Single-Phase Permanent Magnet Linear Oscillation Actuator
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Symposium on Linear Drives for Industry Applications (LDIA)
abstract: Single-phase permanent magnet linear oscillation actuators (SP-PMLOA) have been paid extensive attention in the field of compressors and industry applications. However, the detent force of SP-PMLOA limits the effective stroke and affects the control accuracy of the system. The purpose of this paper is to present a novel C-core SP-PMLOA with double stators arc-teeth and auxiliary slots to reduce detent force. Firstly, the basic structure and dynamic equation of the traditional linear oscillation actuator are introduced. Then, considering the magnetic flux leakage, the detent force formulation is derived by the flux tube method, and a novel structure is presented to reduce detent force. Finally, for verifying the feasibility of the novel structure, the traditional and presented structures of C-core SP-PMLOA are analyzed by 2-D finite element analysis (FEA) mothed. The results show that the presented novel structure can significantly reduce the detent force and increase the effective stroke.

articleTitle: Fault-Tolerant Control for Five-Leg Two-Mover Permanent-Magnet Linear Motor Traction Systems with Open-Phase Fault
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Symposium on Linear Drives for Industry Applications (LDIA)
abstract: In this paper, the single-phase open-circuit (SPOC) fault for five-leg two-mover permanent-magnet linear motor traction system is investigated and modeled. A loss mode is developed for traction system with minimum copper loss under SPOC fault. By the finite-control-set model predictive control (FCS-MPC), the fault-tolerant control method is implemented and the traction system is well operated with minimum copper loss. All the theoretical analysis is verified by simulation results.

articleTitle: Iron Loss Modeling and Analysis of Grain oriented Silicon Steel Sheet under Multi-harmonic Hybrid Magnetization
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Symposium on Linear Drives for Industry Applications (LDIA)
abstract: Dynamic and static hysteresis properties as well as loss properties of oriented silicon steel sheet under the sinusoidal excitation and multi-harmonic excitation are measured respectively. Then, we simulate the static hysteresis and loss properties by Preisach model. Next, we propose an improved method of excess loss parameter extraction under sinusoidal excitation based on the equivalent relationship between loss separation and magnetic field separation, which is more accurate to predict the dynamic hysteresis properties as well as loss properties than traditional method. Based on above improved method, the field quantity expression corresponding to the excess loss under multi-harmonic excitation was constructed, thus we propose a dynamic hysteresis model of oriented silicon steel sheet under arbitrary complex multi-harmonic excitation. We verified the accuracy and effectiveness of the improved dynamic hysteresis model and the loss prediction algorithm proposed in this paper by comparing the predicted results with the measured ones under all kinds of working conditions.

articleTitle: Position Sensor-less Piston Stroke Estimation Method for Linear Oscillatory Machines Based on Sliding Mode Observer
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Symposium on Linear Drives for Industry Applications (LDIA)
abstract: For the linear compressor system driven by linear oscillatory machine (LOM), the piston stroke signal is very important to realize the efficient control of the motor. Since it is difficult to install a position sensor in the LOM, and the position sensor will increase the difficulty of system control, it is necessary to use an accurate and efficient position sensor-less method to estimate the piston stroke signal. In this paper, a novel position sensor-less piston stroke estimation method based on sliding-mode observer (SMO) is proposed. Besides, a self-adaptive band-pass filter (SABPF) is designed to filter the estimated piston stroke signal, which not only overcomes the pure integration problem, but also solves the chattering problem of SMO. Simulation results show that the proposed SMO has a good performance in estimation accuracy, and the chattering problem is well solved.

articleTitle: Investigation of a Novel Linear Partitioned Primary Hybrid-excited Consequent-pole Flux-reversal Permanent Magnet Machine
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Symposium on Linear Drives for Industry Applications (LDIA)
abstract: This paper proposes a novel linear partitioned hybrid-excited consequent-pole flux-reversal machine featuring a wide flux adjusting range with less PM consumption. Due to the space confliction between armature and field windings in conventional hybrid-excited machine, the consequent-pole partitioned primary structure is employed to improve the PM utilization ratio and further enhance the flux regulation capability. Firstly, the topology, operation principle and flux regulation principle are introduced. Then, using finite element method (FEM), the dimensional parameters of the proposed machine and a conventional machine for comparison are globally optimized for higher thrust force and wider flux adjusting range. The electrical performance of optimized structures including open-circuit phase back-electromotive force (back-EMF), flux adjusting capability and force characteristics are investigated. The proposed machine is observed to have better flux regulation capability than conventional machine with improved PM utilization ratio, which means it is suitable for wide speed range system applications.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of a Novel Dual-Stator Tubular Linear Machine with Split Teeth Structure
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Symposium on Linear Drives for Industry Applications (LDIA)
abstract: In this paper, a dual-stator tubular linear machine (DSTLM) is proposed with low detent force and low thrust force ripple by using the split teeth structure. The machine adopts a dual-stator configuration with spoke-type permanent magnets (PMs) on the translator. The phase-group concentrated-coil windings are designed on the outer stator, while the inner stator has no windings. Every stator tooth is divided into three split teeth to modulate the air gap magnetic flux. The stator-shift method is applied to suppress the detent force. And different types of stator teeth are designed to analyze the performance of the machine. Finally, the performance of the proposed DSTLM is compared with the basic model by finite element method (FEM). According to the results, the proposed DSTLM has the advantages of low detent force and low thrust force ripple.

articleTitle: Upgraded Limited-Step Predictive Current Control Strategy for Linear Induction Machine based on Linear Metro
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Symposium on Linear Drives for Industry Applications (LDIA)
abstract: This paper emphasizes improving the control algorithm for speed regulation of the linear induction machine (LIM) used in the linear metro application. The main objective is to improve the conventional limited step predictive current control (LSPCC) scheme by considering all disturbances in the speed loop, thereafter the motor speed becomes less effective by any disturbance or load variation. The suggested scheme also improves the reaching time of the LSPCC by using a robust sliding mode controller (SMC) instead of the traditional PID controller on the outer speed loop. The proposed control strategy can decrease the time for LIM to retain the desired value rapidly, and also make the system more stable while changing speed and load. Simulation and experiment results validate the control method credibility and prove the superiority of the proposed scheme.
