The proposed strategies are presented with only two sets of driving signals to achieve low harmonic distortion, which can reduce the complexity of the system and potentially contribute to circuit topology design. The correlation of switching signals and principle of the control strategies are analyzed by establishing the state-space average model of the topology. Moreover, the current characteristics of filter capacitor is considered, which can provide mechanism analysis for the design of filter circuit. The experimental results are presented and high precision of output current is achieved.

articleTitle: Analytical Calculation of Magnetic Field in Surface-Mounted Permanent-Magnet Linear Machine Accounting for slots
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Symposium on Linear Drives for Industry Applications (LDIA)
abstract: This paper presented a novel method for analytical calculation of magnetic field in surface-mounted permanent-magnet linear machine(PMLM) accounting for magnet-pole shape and slots. Equivalent surface current method, the method of mirror image, superposition principle, and conformal mapping are combined to obtain magnetic field taking into account magnet-pole shape and slots. The analytical results of flux density of PMLM are compared with finite element(FE) results. The FE results confirm that the developed analytical method is well for predicting magnetic field.

articleTitle: Multi-Objective Optimization of the Linear Induction Motor by a Hybrid Optimal Strategy
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Symposium on Linear Drives for Industry Applications (LDIA)
abstract: This paper presents a hybrid optimization method based on the multi-Support Vector Machine (multi-SVM) and Kriging method for linear induction motors (LIMs). With this novel method, the optimal schemes can satisfy various performance specifications of LIMs after multi-objective optimization process. The raw data including structural parameters and performance indexes are obtained from finite element analysis (FEA). Utilizing multi-SVM, a global analysis model is established to observe the optimization trend under entire reference interval. With the preliminary assessment and range selection, a high-precision interval model based on Kriging method enhances the efficiency and accuracy of analysis. The adjustable objective function ultimately determines the design scheme and realizes the optimization objectives of the thrust force, thrust ripple, vertical force, current, power factor, copper loss and weight simultaneously.

articleTitle: Modeling and Electromagnetic Performance Analysis of a Novel DC Hybrid Magnetic Bearing with Crossed Poles
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Symposium on Linear Drives for Industry Applications (LDIA)
abstract: This paper discusses a novel DC hybrid magnetic bearing (HMB) with crossed poles, which the independent levitation magnetic circuits with two degrees of freedom (two-DOF) are obtained. The two-DOF levitation forces are naturally decoupled. Firstly, the configuration and levitation principle are introduced, respectively. Secondly, the mathematical models of the levitation force are deduced. Finally, the three-dimensional finite element analysis is carried out to analyze the electromagnetic performances. Furthermore, comparative researches are carried out with the traditional HMB. The research results have shown that the structure and magnetic circuit of the new HMB are correct. There is no force coupling, and large levitation force can be obtained.

articleTitle: High-precision Position Measurement for Linear Motor Mover Based on PCSAC
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Symposium on Linear Drives for Industry Applications (LDIA)
abstract: To achieve high-precision and real-time measurement of the mover position of a permanent magnet linear synchronous motor (PMLSM), a PCSAC-based visual measurement method for the mover position of a linear motor is proposed. First, take the non-periodic fence fringe image as the target to take the image and collect it by the linear CCD camera on the linear motor mover. Then, the phase correlation algorithm is used to calculate the phase angle vector in the frequency domain of the two pictures. Finally, the least truncated squares (LTS) are used for linear fitting to find the slope in the frequency domain and calculate the distance in the spatial domain, to realize the sub-pixel measurement of the displacement of the linear motor mover. Simulations and experiments prove that the proposed method can effectively achieve high-precision and rapid measurement of mover position.

articleTitle: A Zero-Position Correction Method for a Novel 6-DOF Magnetic Levitation Motor Using Excitation Current
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Symposium on Linear Drives for Industry Applications (LDIA)
abstract: In order to reduce the position measurement deviation caused by the machining and sensor installation errors, the paper proposes a zero-position correction method for a novel 6-DOF magnetic levitation motor using excitation current. A 6-DOF measurement system for the motor is introduced. The excitation current model is derived in terms of the mechanical structure and electromagnetic characteristics of the motor. Based on the relationship between the excitation current and the position of the mover when the mover is stably levitated, the zero-position offsets could be calculated to correct the zero-position of the measurement system. The experimental results verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on Fuzzy Sliding Mode Control Algorithm for Permanent Magnet Synchronous Linear Motor
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Symposium on Linear Drives for Industry Applications (LDIA)
abstract: In order to solve the chattering problem caused by switching gain in traditional sliding mode control permanent magnet synchronous linear motor (PMLSM) system, an improved fuzzy sliding mode variable structure control algorithm was proposed. Firstly, according to the mathematical formula of PMLSM, the corresponding dynamic model and state equation are established. Then, the switching gain was fuzzed according to the fuzzy control algorithm for the chattering phenomenon on the sliding mode surface. And the result of the fuzzy solution was added to the sliding mode controller. The sliding mode control algorithm was used to quickly converge the system motion state to the equilibrium point, which improves the robustness of the system and weakens the chattering phenomenon. At the same time, the feasibility of the algorithm and the stability of the system are proved theoretically by using Lyapunov method. Finally, through the system simulation, the velocity response curves under different control algorithms are compared and analyzed. It is further proved that the proposed control algorithm can not only effectively reduce chattering phenomenon, but also has better tracking performance and stronger robustness.

articleTitle: Predictive Thrust Control without Optimal Weighting Factor Based on Robust Primary Flux Constraint for Linear Induction Machine
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Symposium on Linear Drives for Industry Applications (LDIA)
abstract: The model predictive thrust control (MPTC) is recognized as an effective approach for a linear induction machine (LIM). The flexibility of MPTC can achieve more control targets. However, the weighting factors in the multiple control objectives need to be tuned. It can greatly increase the complexity of controller design. Based on the robust primary flux constraint and fuzzy probability, a novel predictive thrust control without optimal weighting factor is proposed in this paper. As a result, weighting factor selection is avoided, which can reduce computation time, and increase dynamic response. At last, the performance of the proposed method has been verified by comprehensive simulation results.

articleTitle: Thrust Optimization Of Low Speed And Large Thrust Linear Motor Based On Double Fractional Slot Winding
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Symposium on Linear Drives for Industry Applications (LDIA)
abstract: In this paper, a double-layer fractional slot winding structure is proposed in the cylindrical permanent magnet linear motor to solve the problem that in low-speed and large-thrust occasions, the single-layer winding permanent magnet linear motor (PMSM) is inefficient due to its large distance and large thrust fluctuation. By establishing its finite element analysis model and using the Ansoft software, it is proved that the steady state performance of the Double-layer winding fractional-slot is far superior to the Single-layer winding structure and the Double-layer winding fractional-slot is more suitable for low-speed and large-thrust occasions.

articleTitle: Design and Experiment of Permanent Magnet Tubular Linear Generator Using Mechanical Vertical Vibration Energy
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Symposium on Linear Drives for Industry Applications (LDIA)
abstract: This paper presents a permanent magnet tubular linear generator system for powering passive sensors using vertical vibration harvesting energy. The system consists of a permanent magnet tubular linear vibration generator and electric circuits. By using the design of mechanical resonant movers, the generator is capable of converting low frequencies small amplitude vertical vibration energy into more regular sinusoidal electrical energy. The distribution of the magnetic field and electromotive force are calculated by Finite Element Analysis. The characteristics of the linear vibration generator system are observed. The experimental results show the generator can produce about 0.4W∼1.6W electrical power when the vibration source's amplitude is fixed on 2mm and the frequencies are between 13Hz and 22Hz.

articleTitle: Complete modeling and analysis of high-speed rail transit synchronous linear motor traction system
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Symposium on Linear Drives for Industry Applications (LDIA)
abstract: Aiming at the linear traction of high-speed rail transit, a complete model is put forward taking the power supply, converter, linear synchronous motor, vehicle and motor control into account. Especially the analysis is conducted focusing on the influence of the electromagnetic parameters of linear motor and the converter control parameters onto the electromagnetic thrust. With comparison of the simulation and test results, the model could be optimized so as to provide reference and guideline in real application.
